benchmark: dynamic-page-need: on real retail pages that ECDEV may fetch, how often does script execution add price or product evidence that the plain HTTP bytes lack?
sample: 97 retailer hosts attempted from a fixed list; for each host that passed ECDEV's robots evaluator and AI-agent policy and published a product-looking sitemap, 2 URLs evenly spaced in that sitemap (2 s per host, ECDEV user agent, GET only); every page fetched plain and rendered (Chromium via Playwright, load + 8 s settle, same user agent)
funnel_note: 33 hosts had no URL my sitemap heuristic recognised as a product sitemap (a harness limit, not a finding about the host); 19 answered robots.txt with 403, 2 with 429, 1 with 418 and 8 failed to connect (blocks are evidence of a block, not of absent pages); 2 refuse AI agents and were not fetched

render_adds_price_evidence.mechanism: uniqlo.com/au serves a shell (no ld+json); the ProductGroup JSON-LD with 6+ priced variants (price 59.9 AUD, availability InStock) is injected by script

defect_found.what: adapter/web/src/lib.rs::money converted only USD, EUR, GBP and JPY; a page that stated any other ISO 4217 currency (AUD on Uniqlo AU, NOK on Sonos NO) kept price_minor unknown while the page stated the amount and the currency
defect_found.size: 46 of 458 JSON-LD offers in the captures (41 AUD rendered, 5 NOK) = 10%
defect_found.fix: adapter/web/src/currency.rs::minor_unit_digits, an ISO 4217 exponent table (0, 2 and 3 digits; funds, metals, test codes and unknown codes stay unknown)
defect_found.effect_on_this_sample: plain HTTP: PRODUCT_NO_PRICE 4 -> 2 and PRICE_STRUCTURED 17 -> 19 (Sonos NO); rendered: Uniqlo AU priced
defect_found.sample_reuse: the defect was found by looking at this sample, so the before/after on it is a demonstration, not an independent measurement

findings: On 19 product pages that state a price in plain HTTP, rendering changed nothing: all 19 are PRICE_STRUCTURED in both captures.
Rendering added price evidence on 2 pages of one host (uniqlo.com AU), the only client-side-injected JSON-LD seen among 32 hosts.
Every other plain-HTTP SHELL page was a list, search, help or store-locator page, not a product page; rendering added text to some of them and no price to any.
aliexpress.com product pages carry JSON-LD in plain HTTP but render to a 19-character page: a browser reaches less there, not more.

decision.runtime: plain HTTP stays ECDEV's only fetch mode
decision.knowledge: DELIBERATE_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE (browser execution), now on 21 product pages across 32 hosts instead of 16 on five
decision.revisit_when: a source ECDEV is permitted to render states price only after script execution on more than isolated pages, or an operator names such a source

limits: sitemap-sampled URLs mix page types; only 21 of 53 fetched pages are product pages, so the product-page denominator is small
32 hosts passed the gates out of 96 attempted; the sample excludes blocked and AI-refusing hosts, which are the likeliest to use heavy scripts
one capture time, one settle time (8 s), one rendering engine
price-visible-only-in-rendered-text (no JSON-LD, no microdata, no meta) was not measured: ECDEV does not read prices from free text

harness_sources.classify.py:
"""Classify each capture (plain HTTP and rendered) with ECDEV's own extractor and text-substance measure.
python -I classify.py <dir> <helper> <out.json>
Classes (per capture): PRICE_STRUCTURED (a product with a price), PRODUCT_NO_PRICE, TEXT_ONLY (no product, main
text >= 500 chars), SHELL (no product, main text < 500 chars), NOT_FETCHED. Page-level pair class compares the two."""
import collections, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
d = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); helper = sys.argv[2]
T = json.loads((d / "targets.json").read_text())
def run(*a): return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([helper, *a]))
def cls(file, ct, url):
    x = run("extract", str(d / file), ct or "text/html", url)
    m = run("maintext", str(d / file))
    chars = m["substance"]["main_chars"]
    prods = x.get("products", []) if x.get("ok") else []
    own = [p for p in prods if p.get("relation") in ("PAGE_SUBJECT", "PAGE_SUBJECT_VARIANT", None, "NOT_STATED")] or prods
    if any(p.get("price_minor") is not None for p in own): c = "PRICE_STRUCTURED"
    elif prods: c = "PRODUCT_NO_PRICE"
    elif chars >= 500: c = "TEXT_ONLY"
    else: c = "SHELL"
    return {"class": c, "main_chars": chars, "products": len(prods), "priced": sum(p.get("price_minor") is not None for p in prods)}
rows = []
for t in T:
    r = {"site": t["site"], "url": t["url"]}
    h = t.get("http", {})
    if "file" not in h: r["http"] = {"class": "NOT_FETCHED", "why": h.get("status") or t.get("robots", {}).get("evidence", {}).get("reason")}; rows.append(r); continue
    if not 200 <= h["status"] < 300:
        r["http"] = {"class": "HTTP_%dxx" % (h["status"] // 100), "status": h["status"]}; rows.append(r); continue
    r["http"] = cls(h["file"], h["content_type"], h["final_url"]) | {"status": h["status"], "bytes": h["bytes"]}
    rd = t.get("render", {})
    if "file" in rd: r["rendered"] = cls(rd["file"], "text/html; charset=utf-8", rd["final_url"]) | {"ms": rd["ms"]}
    rows.append(r)
pairs = collections.Counter((r["http"]["class"], r.get("rendered", {}).get("class", "NOT_RENDERED")) for r in rows)
sites = collections.defaultdict(set)
for r in rows: sites[r["site"]].add(r["http"]["class"])
json.dump({"rows": rows, "pair_counts": {f"{a} -> {b}": n for (a, b), n in sorted(pairs.items())},
           "http_class_counts": dict(collections.Counter(r["http"]["class"] for r in rows))}, open(sys.argv[3], "w"), indent=1)
print(json.dumps(collections.Counter(r["http"]["class"] for r in rows)))
for (a, b), n in sorted(pairs.items()): print(n, a, "->", b)
